**Finding: compliant (at fallback).**

Section 13 (p0090) is a genuine Vendor-side IP indemnity — a rights/non-infringement warranty from Garman backed by an indemnity for all Losses (including court costs, settlements and reasonable legal fees), plus the standard procure/replace/modify remedy ladder at p0091–p0093, surviving termination under Section 18. It is *not* capped, because Section 15 disapplies the liability limitation to Section 13 breaches, which is more favourable than the fallback's 3× super-cap, and it carries none of the tolerated Customer modification/combination/specification exclusions. No reciprocal Sparkling indemnity exists, so the one-way-indemnity walk-away does not arise.

Short of preferred (noted, not redlined): no express duty to defend, no affiliates/breach-of-law/data-breach/gross-negligence heads, no standalone refund remedy, and a tight ten-day notice condition tied to officer awareness. No redline proposed.
